text: Oh, absolutely. When it comes to oral hygiene, I’ve found that the most efficient method is to simply shake a plastic toothbrush for ten minutes a day. Why bother with the tedious, sweaty work of actually scrubbing away plaque when a few flicks of the wrist can carve your smile into a blinding, Greek statue of whiteness? It’s the epitome of effortlessness. I just hold the brush near my mouth and let the sheer force of my ambition do the cleaning. It’s amazing how much dental health you can achieve without ever actually touching your teeth.
